Press Release

Sony FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G debuts – a compact full-frame fisheye zoom

SAN DIEGO, Calif. — September 8, 2026 — FilmTools
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:11
Instaread

SAN DIEGO, Calif. — September 8, 2026 — The FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G brings Sony’s first full-frame E-mount fisheye zoom to photographers and filmmakers, offering an 8–14mm range that covers everything from full-frame circular fisheye at the wide end to a natural diagonal fisheye at 14 mm. The lens is intended for stills, movie work and professional VR capture where expressive wide-angle perspective and compact size matter.

The FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G (SEL814G) is designed around a compact optical formula using ED and aspherical elements to control chromatic aberration and preserve high resolution across the extreme field of view. It features a constant f/3.5 aperture through the zoom range, a 0.15 m minimum focus distance, and a lightweight chassis at approximately 314 g.

FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G – key capabilities

The lens covers a 180° angle of view at the wide end and offers a continuous shift from circular to diagonal fisheye projection as you zoom from 8–14 mm. Optical corrections including four ED elements and three aspherical elements help deliver clean detail with minimal color fringing, while a circular 7-blade aperture supports smooth highlight rendering.

Autofocus is driven by a linear motor for fast, accurate and quiet operation suitable for both stills and movies. Focus breathing has been reduced for steadier framing during motion, and Linear Response MF provides intuitive manual-focus control when precision is required.

Design, handling, and professional uses

The SEL814G’s compact dimensions (Φ63.1 mm × 82.8 mm) and modest 314 g weight make it well suited to handheld shooting, gimbals, and dual‑camera VR rigs where size and balance are essential. Independent focus, zoom and iris rings plus internal zooming maintain balance across the range, and a rear filter holder accepts standard sheet filters for production workflows.

For 3D VR capture, matched pairs of FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G lenses can be set approximately at typical interpupillary spacing to reproduce natural spatial depth in stereoscopic rigs. The lens’ 63.1 mm diameter is specifically noted by Sony as a practical fit for paired VR rigs.

Use cases and workflows

Photographers and cinematographers will find the FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G useful for environmental portraits, architecture, landscapes, creative wedding imagery, and immersive VR content. Its expressive fisheye geometry invites new compositional approaches, from exaggerated foregrounds to enveloping interior scenes that place the viewer inside the space.

On-location reliability is supported by dust- and moisture-resistant construction and a fluorine coating on the front element to keep contaminants from sticking and to facilitate cleaning between takes.
